text:
keinsaas Navigator – Community Edition

 

 

 formerly better-chatbot 

 An open-source AI chat and agent platform you can host yourself. 

Talk to any model, attach your files, connect MCP tool servers, build workflows,
and give agents a place to work — on infrastructure you control.

 
 

 

---

 Deploy to Vercel

 

Two required values, a few optional ones. The button clones the repository,
creates a free Supabase project for the database and file uploads, and asks
for:

 Variable 
 --- --- 
 BETTER AUTH SECRET Required. Any long random string ( openssl rand -base64 32 ). 
 AI GATEWAY API KEY Required. From vercel.com/ai-gateway. Serves every model in the catalog, including realtime voice. 
 COMPOSIO API KEY Optional. Lets users connect Gmail, Slack, GitHub and more. Free key 
 TENSORX API KEY Optional. EU-hosted models from our partner TensorX. 
 ASSEMBLYAI API KEY Optional. Voice transcription via AssemblyAI. 
 EXA API KEY Optional. Web search via Exa. 
 E2B API KEY Optional. Sandboxes that run generated code, via E2B. Without it, code runs in the browser. 
 INNGEST EVENT KEY , INNGEST SIGNING KEY Optional. Scheduled agents and background jobs, via Inngest. Easiest: add the Inngest integration in Vercel, which sets both and connects the app. 

The optional fields are pre-filled with optional ; leave them like that and the
feature stays off. You can add any key later under Settings → Environment
Variables and redeploy. The database schema and the storage buckets are
created during the build. Open the deployment and create an account; the first
one becomes the administrator.

Free Supabase projects pause after a week without use. If your app stops
loading after a quiet week, open the project in the Supabase dashboard and
click Restore .

 Updates come to you. After your first sign-in, the app asks once to
 Turn on automatic updates: it opens GitHub with the update check ready,
and you click Commit changes . From then on your copy checks every week.
When there is a new version, GitHub emails you a short guide: try the preview
Vercel builds, then click Merge . Nothing changes in your live app until
you do.

Details and optional features: docs/self-hosting.md.

---

 Quick start (Docker)

Three variables. That is the whole configuration to get chatting:

 

 

 

Open and create an account. The first account becomes the
administrator.

 Why one model key? Models are served through the Vercel AI Gateway, which
fronts Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot and more. You
manage one key and one bill instead of seven, and you can switch models
mid-conversation without touching configuration. If you would rather not use a
gateway at all, point the app at Ollama, LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible
endpoint — see Models.

Prefer running it directly? See docs/self-hosting.md.

---

 See it in action

 Web search

Ask about anything current and get an answer with its sources. Needs the optional EXA API KEY .

 

 Charts and tables

One sentence in, a chart or an interactive table out.

 

 Code execution

Python and JavaScript run in a sandbox; results come back as tables and charts. Needs the optional E2B API KEY .

 

 Agents

Mention an agent with @ and it takes over the conversation with its own instructions and tools.

 

 Legal document review

An example from the agent library: paste a clause or attach a contract, and the Legal Document Reviewer flags the risks and suggests changes.

 

 Image generation

Generate images right inside the conversation.

 

 Tools and MCP servers

Connect your apps and any MCP server. The catalog of 250+ apps comes with the optional Composio integration.

 

 TensorX: EU-hosted, zero data retention

Pick a model under TensorX (0 Data Retention) and your prompts go straight to EU infrastructure that keeps nothing. Needs the optional TENSORX API KEY ; see Partners.

 

 Local models

At the end of the model menu, Add local Model connects Ollama, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server. Your data stays on your hardware.

 

 Voice input

Click the microphone, speak, and your words are transcribed into the message box by AssemblyAI. Needs the optional ASSEMBLYAI API KEY .

 

 Desktop app (beta)

The keinsaas Navigator desktop app for Windows and macOS, with local (stdio) MCP servers and native notifications. It connects to the cloud or to your own instance; see What you get.

 

---

 What you get

 Chat that does things. Streaming conversations with tool calling, file
attachments, image generation, and a sandboxed code runner. Mention an agent,
workflow, or tool with @ to pull it into the conversation.

 Agents. Give an agent a role, instructions, and a set of tools. Share it
with your workspace or keep it private.

 Skills. Reusable capabilities an agent loads on demand, so a large toolbox
does not have to sit in every prompt.

 Projects with retrieval. Group chats, documents, and tools around a piece of
work. Uploaded documents are chunked, embedded, and searched with pgvector —
no external service required. Point a project at a knowledge base if you want
hosted retrieval instead.

 Workflows. Build a graph of steps — LLM calls, conditions, HTTP requests,
code, templates — in a visual editor, publish it as a tool, and call it from any
chat.

 MCP tool servers. Connect any Model Context Protocol server over HTTP or
stdio, with OAuth support, per-tool customization and a cached tool list.
Self-hosted instances can run stdio servers; the desktop app runs them locally.

 Scheduled tasks. Have an agent run on a schedule and report back.

 Voice. Realtime voice conversations through the gateway, plus transcription.

 Voice device. Pair an M5Stack Atom Echo S3R,
press its button and talk: what you say is transcribed and handed to your
agent with its tools, or turned into a new agent or a scheduled task. Pairing and device management are in
the app; the device streams its audio through a small WebSocket bridge, which
is not published for sel

install.title: Quick start (Docker)
install.html:
Three variables. That is the whole configuration to get chatting:

git clone https://github.com/keinsaasforever/better-chatbot.git
cd better-chatbot
cp .env.example .env

POSTGRES_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/better_chatbot
BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=   # npx @better-auth/cli@latest secret
AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY=   # https://vercel.com/ai-gateway

docker compose -f docker/compose.yml up -d --build

Open http://localhost:3000 and create an account. The first account becomes the administrator.

Why one model key? Models are served through the Vercel AI Gateway, which fronts Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot and more. You manage one key and one bill instead of seven, and you can switch models mid-conversation without touching configuration. If you would rather not use a gateway at all, point the app at Ollama, LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — see Models.

Prefer running it directly? See docs/self-hosting.md.
